dct_description_sm: The purpose of this project was to investigate the evolution of seawater pH as it froze, formed sea ice, and diversified into distinct ice and seawater media, including  bulk solid ice, sea ice brine, and frost flowers. pH is an infrequently measured parameter in sea ice brine and bulk ice because it is very sensitive to atmospheric exposure, as well as to temperature changes. However, pH is a fundamental parameter that if measured accurately enough can help validate other carbonate system parameters and characterize the chemical composition of aquatic systems.
dct_title_s: Experimental sea ice pH from the Sea-ice Environmental Research Facility (SERF), University of Manitoba
